NO EDGE REDEPLOY (new RPC + catalogue; no accrual.js/core/data change; pack-edge hr-accrue --check unaffected). §5 structural + §6 behavioural self-check PROVED on production apply in an HRG27-rolled-back subtxn: unknown + shop ids refused not_grantable; a legit non-shop pet (wolf_pup) grants (row + version bump + hr_state_of owned projection + equippable via hr_companion_equip); a replay is already_owned with no second write/bump; the hatch consumes exactly one egg when held; zero residue. Client DORMANT: src/features/companions.js maybeServerGrant (fired from unlockCompanion — covers drops+hatch here, the bunny quest, and pets.js skill/boss which call window.unlockCompanion) fires src/net/goal-claim.js grantCompanion ONLY under blobRetired() (the capstone arm), skipping shop + starter; dormant it makes NO network call, so the local ownedIds write is byte-for-byte today.
